summary_en: USS completed adjustment trading for its facility-type share buyback program. The 24th warrant was exercised by SMBC Nikko Securities, resulting in net treasury share acquisition of 9,580,100 shares with total expenditure of 17,999,911,800 yen, representing approximately 7.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notification of Completion of Adjustment Trading in Facility-Type Treasury Share Acquisition
translation_en_brief:
USS Co., Ltd. announced the completion of adjustment trading related to its facility-type treasury share acquisition program on October 2, 2026. The company initially announced the program on May 12, 2026, with trading executed on May 13, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange transaction). SMBC Nikko Securities exercised the 24th series of warrants on October 2, 2026, which finalized the adjustment trading mechanism.

The net result of the facility-type acquisition is 9,580,100 treasury shares acquired at an average volume-weighted average price (VWAP) of 1,915.3763 yen per share for a total expenditure of 17,999,911,800 yen. This represents approximately 7.8% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The adjustment mechanism involved SMBC Nikko Securities selling 8,317,000 shares to USS and USS acquiring 7,564,200 shares at the calculated average VWAP, with the difference of 752,800 shares delivered through warrant exercise at 1 yen per share.

The VWAP calculation was based on the average price from May 14, 2026, through October 1, 2026, adjusted to 99.80% of the simple arithmetic mean, excluding specified trading days and period-end dates. The total acquisition amount of approximately 18 billion yen remained unchanged from the initial transaction.
